messages:
Isha: dropped a compact prototype for the trace header — figma: https://www.figma.com/file/trace/compact-header
Isha: main goals: reduce visual noise, collapse long correlation ids, single prominent export CTA that people can use quickly
Cal: copy check: 'Download snapshot' vs 'Save capture' vs 'Export trace'. My vote: 'Download snapshot' (clear for non-devs)
Rory: ok to use 'Download snapshot' as primary. Offer formats in kebab: 'Download as HAR', 'Download full bundle (incl. KV)'. tooltip for primary: 'Quick snapshot (JSON)'
Jun: perf note: building full bundle with KV is heavy. surface an estimated size + span count before kicking off. queue big jobs and return signed url (TTL 10m)
Isha: mock shows size chip: '~ 2.9 MB  1,120 spans' next to CTA. chip updates when filters change
a11y-bot: auto-scan: size-chip contrast 3.1:1 on 2030012372. Needs >=4.5:1 for small text. Recommend bolder text or darker bg. Also suggest aria-live='polite' on chip so screen readers get updates
Cal: add aria-label on CTA that includes trace id, e.g. aria-label='Download snapshot for trace 0x7c3a'. Keep tab order: Search -> Filters -> CTA -> Kebab
Rory: correlation id pill: show first 8 chars + ellipsis, hover reveals full id with copy button. Add 'Pin id' toggle to persist expanded state
Jun: infra-bot: will implement export job endpoint. returns {job_id, estimated_size, span_count}. Rate-limit large jobs and create background worker INFRA-999
Isha: micro-interaction: when export is ready show a persistent toast: 'Snapshot ready — Download • Copy link'. include keyboard hint 'Press D then L to download'
a11y-bot: also recommend focus behavior: move focus to toast link when it appears, make it tabbable, and announce via aria-live; ensure toast doesn't steal keyboard focus unexpectedly
Cal: permission gating: only show CTA to users with 'trace:download' role. others see disabled button with 'Request access' tooltip that opens modal
Rory: telemetry: events = trace_snapshot_clicked, export_format_selected, export_job_completed (include span_count + estimated_size), export_kv_opt_in
Isha: decision summary: primary label 'Download snapshot' with small 'JSON' tooltip, kebab for other formats, show estimated size + span count (aria-live), collapsed correlation id + pin option, permission gating, contrast fix for size chip, background job + signed url infra. Isha -> will update figma and add a11y checklist
Jun: noted. I'll add the infra ticket and prototype the size endpoint.
Isha: thanks all — will follow up with a short decision note and updated frames. :raised_hands:
